00099| 
00100| The path of the font file as a string or an array of objects (with type `Array<{path: string, weight?: string, style?: string}>`) relative to the directory where the font loader function is called.
00101| 
00102| Used in `next/font/local`
00103| 
00104| - Required
00105| 
00106| Examples:
00107| 
00108| - `src:'./fonts/my-font.woff2'` where `my-font.woff2` is placed in a directory named `fonts` inside the `app` directory
00109| - `src:[{path: './inter/Inter-Thin.ttf', weight: '100',},{path: './inter/Inter-Regular.ttf',weight: '400',},{path: './inter/Inter-Bold-Italic.ttf', weight: '700',style: 'italic',},]`
00110| - if the font loader function is called in `app/page.tsx` using `src:'../styles/fonts/my-font.ttf'`, then `my-font.ttf` is placed in `styles/fonts` at the root of the project
00111| 
00112| ### `weight`
00113| 
00114| The font [`weight`](https://fonts.google.com/knowledge/glossary/weight) with the following possibilities:
00115| 
00116| - A string with possible values of the weights available for the specific font or a range of values if it's a [variable](https://fonts.google.com/variablefonts) font
00117| - An array of weight values if the font is not a [variable google font](https://fonts.google.com/variablefonts). It applies to `next/font/google` only.
00118| 
00119| Used in `next/font/google` and `next/font/local`
00120| 
00121| - Required if the font being used is **not** [variable](https://fonts.google.com/variablefonts)
00122| 
00123| Examples:
00124| 
00125| - `weight: '400'`: A string for a single weight value - for the font [`Inter`](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Inter?query=inter), the possible values are `'100'`, `'200'`, `'300'`, `'400'`, `'500'`, `'600'`, `'700'`, `'800'`, `'900'` or `'variable'` where `'variable'` is the default)
00126| - `weight: '100 900'`: A string for the range between `100` and `900` for a variable font
00127| - `weight: ['100','400','900']`: An array of 3 possible values for a non variable font
00128| 
00129| ### `style`
00130| 
00131| The font [`style`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/CSS/font-style) with the following possibilities:
00132| 
00133| - A string [value](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/CSS/font-style#values) with default value of `'normal'`
00134| - An array of style values if the font is not a [variable google font](https://fonts.google.com/variablefonts). It applies to `next/font/google` only.
00135| 
00136| Used in `next/font/google` and `next/font/local`
00137| 
00138| - Optional
00139| 
00140| Examples:
00141| 
00142| - `style: 'italic'`: A string - it can be `normal` or `italic` for `next/font/google`
00143| - `style: 'oblique'`: A string - it can take any value for `next/font/local` but is expected to come from [standard font styles](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/CSS/font-style)
00144| - `style: ['italic','normal']`: An array of 2 values for `next/font/google` - the values are from `normal` and `italic`
00145| 
00146| ### `subsets`
00147| 
00148| The font [`subsets`](https://fonts.google.com/knowledge/glossary/subsetting) defined by an array of string values with the names of each subset you would like to be [preloaded](/docs/app/api-reference/components/font#specifying-a-subset). Fonts specified via `subsets` will have a link preload tag injected into the head when the [`preload`](#preload) option is true, which is the default.
00149| 
00150| Used in `next/font/google`

{/* The content of this doc is shared between the app and pages router. You can use the `<PagesOnly>Content</PagesOnly>` component to add content that is specific to the Pages Router. Any shared content should not be wrapped in a component. */}

[`next/font`](/docs/app/api-reference/components/font) automatically optimizes your fonts (including custom fonts) and removes external network requests for improved privacy and performance.

It includes **built-in automatic self-hosting** for any font file. This means you can optimally load web fonts with no [layout shift](https://web.dev/articles/cls).

You can also conveniently use all [Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com/). CSS and font files are downloaded at build time and self-hosted with the rest of your static assets. **No requests are sent to Google by the browser.**

<AppOnly>

import { Inter } from 'next/font/google'

// If loading a variable font, you don't need to specify the font weight
